questions.ask: What is your date of birth?
What are the last four digits of the phone number we have on file for you?

hints.day_month_swapped: Could you please say the month as a word?

intents.hardship: The customer mentions illness, a death in the family or job loss.
intents.dispute: "This debt is not mine" or "I never had this product"; a claim that the product was closed or paid off in the past is also a dispute.
intents.already_paid: "I already paid": covers only a payment of this past-due amount.
intents.restructure: A request for a new payment plan or lower instalments.
intents.vague: A vague period such as "next week", "end of the month", "when my salary comes".
intents.too_much: The customer says the full amount is too much.

lines.opening: Hello, this is the digital assistant calling from Freya Bank. We record this call.
lines.robot: Yes, I am Freya Bank's digital assistant.
lines.scam: You can verify this call by phoning Freya Bank's customer service number.
lines.purpose_before_verify: I can explain once I have confirmed I am speaking with the right person.
lines.no_info: I'm sorry, I don't have that information.
lines.not_talk_once: I understand. This will only take a moment.
lines.tp_ask: When would be a good time to reach {title} {last_name}?
lines.tp_ask_time: What time would suit, between 10 am and 7 pm?
lines.tp_outside_window: I'm sorry, I can only call back today or on the next business day, between 10 am and 7 pm. Is there another time that would work?
lines.tp_no_info: I'm sorry, I can only speak with {title} {last_name}.
lines.tp_booked: Thank you. We will call back on {date} at {time}.
lines.wrong_number: I'm sorry for the trouble. Thank you for letting me know.
lines.condolence: I am sorry for your loss.
lines.id_intro: Before we continue, I need to ask you two security questions.
lines.id_explain: The questions protect your account, and I can only continue once you answer them.
lines.id_declined: I understand. I can't continue without the security questions.
lines.id_repeat: Sorry, could you please repeat that?
lines.id_wrong: I'm sorry, that doesn't match our records.
lines.id_failed: I'm sorry, I can't continue with this call. Please use the mobile app or visit a branch.
lines.disclose_intro: Thank you. I am calling from the collections team about a late payment.
lines.product_line: Your {name} has a past-due amount of {amount}, and it is {days} days late.
lines.ask_today: Can you make this payment today?
lines.ask_today_multi: Can you make these payments today?
lines.offer_floor_date: I can offer {amount} on {date}. The rest stays overdue. Would that work for you?
lines.offer_floor: I can offer {amount}. The rest stays overdue. Would that work for you?
lines.below_floor: I'm sorry, I can't record an amount below {floor}. Could you pay {floor}? The rest stays overdue.
lines.below_floor_again: I'm sorry, I can't record that amount.
lines.below_floor_final: I'm sorry, I can't record less than {amount}.
lines.date_past: I'm sorry, the date can't be in the past. Which day from today would work for you?
lines.not_business_day: That day is not a business day. The next business day is {date}. Would that work for you?
lines.after_deadline: The latest date I can record is {date}. Could you make the payment by {date}?
lines.vague_ask: Which exact day would that be?
lines.ask_date_for_amount: On which day could you pay {amount}?
lines.repeat_offer: Just to repeat, could you pay {amount} on {date}?
lines.clamped_note: For your {name}, the latest date I can record is {deadline}.
lines.confirm_again: Sorry, I did not catch that. Do you confirm, yes or no?
lines.recorded: Thank you. Your promise is recorded.
lines.sms_line: You will receive a text message confirming this promise.
lines.record_failed: I'm sorry, I could not record your promise.
lines.paid_line: Thank you for letting me know. Payments can take one business day to appear.
lines.dispute_line: I understand. I will not take a payment promise on this call.
lines.hardship: I'm very sorry to hear that. I will connect you with our customer support team now.
lines.restructure_line: I will connect you with our restructuring team, who can discuss that with you.
lines.human_ask_help: Before I transfer you, is there anything I can help you with?
lines.transfer: I am transferring you now. Please hold.
lines.transfer_failed: I'm sorry, the transfer did not go through.
lines.callback_failed: I'm sorry, I could not book the callback.
lines.system_error: I'm sorry, our system is not responding right now.
lines.anything_else: Is there anything else I can help you with?
lines.promise_change: I can't change or cancel that promise on this call, but you can change it in the mobile app.
lines.goodbye: Thank you for your time. Goodbye.

unsupported_rules: Before identity is verified, the same customer is closed as `not_verified` / `declined`.

sources.rules.refuse_deadline_is_refusal: If the customer refuses the deadline, treat it as a flat refusal (rule 30).
sources.rules.deadline_adjust: If the customer names a weekend day or a holiday that is not after the deadline, offer the next business day.
sources.rules.first_ask: First ask: "Can you make this payment today?".
sources.rules.too_much_floor: Attempt 1 is for the full past-due amount, or for the floor if the customer already said the full amount is too much.
sources.rules.ladder_repeat_last: When the attempts are used up, stop.
sources.rules.hardship_transfer: say one short sentence of sympathy and then do not ask anything: call `transfer_to_agent` with queue `support` straight away and close as `transferred` / `support`.
sources.rules.promise_retries: If it fails, try once more.
sources.rules.week_end_today: If today is that day, propose the last business day of next week.
sources.rules.opening_is_attempt: A no to paying today with no date and no amount is a flat refusal.
sources.identity.max_wrong: Three wrong answers in total end the check, whichever question they were on.
sources.event_changes: From 12 October 2026, a customer who says they already paid (rule 39) is closed as `no_promise` with reason `dispute`, no longer as `paid`.

assumptions: The brief names no currency, so currency_word uses the default 'dollars'.

The memo of 1 October 2026 overrides rule 32. On hardship the agent says one sentence of sympathy and transfers straight to queue 'support' without asking (hardship_transfer = direct). The 'no_promise / hardship' event is kept only as a fallback. The end of rule 32 ('If the customer still names a date or an amount themselves, record the promise') is treated as replaced by 'straight away'.

The memo of 1 October 2026 also changes 'already paid': from 2026-10-12 it closes as no_promise / dispute (event_changes). Before that date it closes as paid with no reason. The paid_line (payments can take one business day to appear) is still said after the change.

Rules 26 and 30 read together: the one floor offer after 'too much' is attempt 1 (the floor on the last business day of this week). In the late band, attempt 2 names the floor again on the deadline (rule 26: 'Attempt 2 may name the floor again, on the deadline'). So too_much_floor = attempt_1.

Ladder: attempt 1 is the full amount (or the floor after 'too much') on the last business day of this week, or next week's if today is that day. Attempt 2 (late band only, attempts = 2) is the floor on the deadline. The early band has 1 attempt, so it uses only step 1.
Attempts count the proposals after the opening ask 'Can you make this payment today?' (opening_is_attempt = false). A no to that question is the flat refusal that uses attempt 1.
Deadlines are the Nth business day after today, so they are always business days. deadline_adjust = next_business_day follows rule 20, which moves a weekend day or holiday to the next business day.
Rule 30 says a non-answer uses one persuasion attempt. max_unclear is not set because the brief gives no re-ask count.
Callback days are 'today or the next business day'. business_days_only = false because 'today' is not limited to business days.
A date of birth given only as numbers is read day, month, year (date_order = dmy), per rule 11.
Rule 45 before verification (close as not_verified / declined) may not be carried by max_not_talk. It is also listed in unsupported_rules.
The brief requires saying the call is recorded. The opening uses 'We record this call.'
after_promise.ask_anything_else uses the default (true) because the brief is silent.
Brief A never uses add_note, so notes.enabled = false and all note values are empty.
Brief A has only one product per call, so the multi settings keep their defaults.
The brief gives no rule for days late outside 1 to 45, so bands_outside is not set.
